objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package (schema, discovery procedure, read-only PowerShell inventory script, and review packet).
evidence: Audit schema rigorously defines required fields including candidate path, category, evidence signals, confidence, size, last modified time, provenance match, safe removal status, and review state.
Discovery document establishes clear separation between verified agent-owned artifacts and unknown/user/system files.
PowerShell inventory script is strictly read-only, containing zero destructive commands (no deletion, uninstallation, registry updates, or file modifications).
risks: Potential edge cases in path resolution on non-Windows platforms (mitigated by designing script for Windows execution environments while adhering to repo constraints).
Accidental inclusion of non-agent paths (mitigated by strict evidence requirements and safe classification defaults).
open_questions: Should future cleanup execution require dual-key authorization alongside Astra approval?
approval_criteria: All schema properties match audit requirements.
PowerShell script is 100% read-only with no side effects.
Discovery guide correctly enforces audit-only constraints.
rejection_criteria: Any destructive command found in inventory script.
Missing required fields in audit schema.
